definition_zh: 粗鲁的；唐突的；生硬无礼的
definition_en: abrupt and offhand in speech or manner, to the point of being rude
core_image: 一句话没说完就把门关上
scene: 柜台后的老店员头也不抬，答话只有两个字。His brusque reply made the customer feel unwelcome.
sceneCN: 这里 brusque 是「生硬无礼的、唐突的」（第 1 个义项：言谈举止 abrupt 且近乎无礼）；句意是他生硬的回话让顾客觉得不受欢迎。

pos.zh: 粗鲁的；唐突的；生硬无礼的

collocations.phrase: brusque to the point of rudeness

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「粗鲁地，唐突地」
由形容词加 -ness 构成，义为「粗鲁，生硬」
借自法语，义为「粗鲁的举止」

senses.title: Abrupt and rude in manner
senses.definition: speaking or behaving in a curt, blunt way that seems rude
senses.definitionCN: 言谈举止简短生硬，显得粗鲁无礼
senses.example: The doctor was brusque but thorough.
senses.exampleCN: 医生态度生硬，检查却很仔细。
senses.why: The French source means brushwood-like, rough; rough manner reads as curtness.
senses.whyCN: 法语原义近于「如灌木丛般毛糙」，毛糙的做派读起来就是简慢无礼。

senses.title: Offhand in speech
senses.definition: giving short, ungracious answers without warmth or explanation
senses.definitionCN: 回答简短冷淡，不带温度也不作解释
senses.example: Her brusque "no comment" ended the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 她生硬的一句「无可奉告」结束了采访。
senses.why: When words are trimmed to the bone, the missing courtesies themselves offend.
senses.whyCN: 话语被削到只剩骨头，缺失的客套本身就成了冒犯，义项由举止落到言语。

senses.title: Bluntly dismissive
senses.titleCN: 断然打发的，不容分说的
senses.definition: curtly rejecting a request or person without ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 干脆利落地回绝请求或冷落来人，不讲情面
senses.example: He gave the proposal a brusque brush-off.
senses.exampleCN: 他把提案一口回绝，毫不客气。
senses.why: Curtness pushed further becomes dismissal: the door closes before the sentence ends.
senses.whyCN: 简慢再进一步便是不容分说的打发，话没说完门已关上，义项继续加深。

intro.en: Brusque came into English from French brusque, which probably traces to an Italian word for brushwood.
intro.cn: brusque 经由法语 brusque 进入英语，一般追溯到意大利语中表示「柴薪、毛糙」的词。

items.en: brusco meant rough, sharp-tasting; older forms pointed to brussa, brushwood prepared for dyeing.
items.cn: 意大利语 brusco 义为粗砺、涩口；更早形式 brussa 指用于染色的荆柴。

items.en: brusque took the meaning brisk and rough in manner, said of wine, then of people.
items.cn: 法语 brusque 先形容气味冲、性子急，继而形容人粗鲁唐突。

items.en: brusque entered English with the sense of blunt, forbidding manner.
items.cn: 十七世纪 brusque 进入英语，表示生硬冷峻的态度。

items.en: derivatives brusquely and brusqueness settled beside the adjective.
items.cn: 派生词 brusquely、brusqueness 随形容词定型。

items.en: brusque now labels any curtness that shades into rudeness.
items.cn: 如今 brusque 泛指一切近乎无礼的简慢生硬。

note.en: Brusque resembles French borrowings of roughness and sits beside a row of curtness words.
note.cn: brusque 与一批源自法语的「粗砺」词形近，并置身一排表简慢的近义词之间。

entries.definitionCN: 意大利语源词，义为粗砺，brusque 的前身
brusque 的名词形式，粗鲁生硬

entries.definition: an implement with bristles; a skirmish
entries.definitionCN: 刷子；小冲突，只是拼形相近，词源不同

entries.definition: plain and direct to the point of rudeness
entries.definitionCN: 直截了当到近乎冒犯的

entries.definition: rough and surly in voice or manner

entries.definitionCN: 随口敷衍的，漫不经心的

normalIntro.en: Hear the French flavor: a brusque man speaks in one brusk syllable.
normalIntro.cn: 听出法语腔：粗鲁人说话只有一个生硬音节。

normal.en: Brusque ends like the French words casque and masque.
normal.cn: brusque 的结尾同法语词 casque、masque 一个路数。
不发音的 -que 藏着 /k/ 音。

normal.en: The variant spelling brusk says the sound out loud.
normal.cn: 异体拼法 brusk 把音直接写出来。

normal.en: Root image: brushwood, prickly and rough to touch.
normal.cn: 词根意象：荆柴，扎手而毛糙。

normal.en: Pair it with curt: both cut words short.
normal.cn: 与 curt 对记：两者都把话剪短。

abstract.en: Feel a door shut on your half-finished sentence.
abstract.cn: 感受半句话被一扇门硬生生截断。

abstract.en: See a hand wave you away without a glance.
abstract.cn: 看见一只手头也不抬地把你挥开。

abstract.en: Hear three clipped words where a paragraph should be.
abstract.cn: 本该一段话的地方只落下三个硬邦邦的词。

examples.en: His brusque phone manner scared off new clients.
examples.cn: 他接电话时生硬的态度吓跑了不少新客户。

examples.en: Behind the brusque exterior, she was kind to interns.
examples.cn: 生硬的外表之下，她对实习生其实很和善。

examples.en: The waiter apologized for the brusque service.
examples.cn: 侍者为粗鲁的服务道了歉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不汝客」——他说话「不」把「汝」当「客」待，三言两语就把人打发，粗鲁唐突。

root: brusque 一般认为借自法语 brusque（毛糙、唐突），更早上溯意大利语 brusco（粗砺、涩口），其源或为 brussa（染料用荆柴），与「刷子」一族的日耳曼借词相关；词形属法语系统，非拉丁古典词。

sensesIntro.en: A rough, brushwood manner reads first as curtness, then as graceless speech, and finally as outright dismissal.
sensesIntro.cn: 如荆柴般毛糙的做派，先读作简慢，再落到生硬的言语，最终成为毫不客气的打发。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door closing on a half-spoken sentence.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇门在半句话上砰然关上。

intro.en: Brusque is a whole-word borrowing; its shape is French, its core Italian.
intro.cn: brusque 是整词借入：词形属法语，词核出自意大利语。

latinIntro.en: No classical Latin root exists; the trail runs through medieval trade Italian.
latinIntro.cn: 并无古典拉丁词根可循，词迹经由中世纪意大利商贸语汇。

items.meaning: plain to the point of rudeness

latinEntries.meaningCN: 缩短的，残缺的（curt 之源）
